issues.failure_explanation: The negation of the theorem's conclusion only yields, for each k, a point z^k such that for every y in Y some component index j(y,k) satisfies bc_{j(y,k)}(y,z^k) > -zeta_k, i.e. max_j bc_j(y,z^k) > -zeta_k for all y. The proof instead asserts a single index j valid for all y and all k, which does not follow (the violated component may vary with y). The subsequent limit argument, c_j(z)=0 and the MFCQ contradiction are all carried out for this fixed j.

issues.overall_effect: The proof of Theorem thm:UniSlater as written is logically incomplete; the statement itself is true and is used by Lemma lambda-bound, Theorem thm:sub_iters and Lemma lambda-uniform-bound, so those results are not invalidated once the proof is repaired.
issues.title: Misquantified negation in the proof of the uniform Slater property (single index j assumed)
issues.why_classification: A short local rewrite of the contradiction argument with the same ingredients (compactness, continuity, MFCQ) fully restores the result; no claim or constant changes.

issues.failure_explanation: With the Lagrangian objective phi (which must also contain q(z), omitted in the displayed definition), phi(yhat)-phi(z^{k+1}) equals <grad g(z^k), yhat - z^{k+1}> + (L_k/2)(||yhat - z^k||^2 - ||z^{k+1}-z^k||^2) + q(yhat) - q(z^{k+1}). The proof bounds the quadratic part by (L_k/2)||yhat - z^{k+1}||^2, which is false in general (e.g. z^k=0, z^{k+1}=1/2, yhat=1 gives 3/4 > 1/4). The final bound (prop1_explicitBound) nevertheless holds because ||yhat - z^k||^2 - ||z^{k+1}-z^k||^2 <= D_Y^2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Include q in phi and replace the quadratic term by (L_k/2)(||yhat^k - z^k||^2 - ||z^{k+1}-z^k||^2) <= (bar L/2) D_Y^2, which yields the same constant A.
issues.overall_effect: Only the intermediate step is wrong; the stated bound A on the multipliers, and its uses in Theorem thm:sub_iters and Lemma lambda-uniform-bound, remain valid after correcting the step.
issues.title: False intermediate inequality in the multiplier bound proof (Lemma lambda-bound)

issues.failure_explanation: The bound ||z^{l+1}-z^l|| <= tau/omega was derived only for l >= bar K_theta - 1, using the rate r_l <= beta tau^2/(2 omega^2) from Lemma lem:added-1. The terminating index k may be much smaller, and the stopping test (subsolver_terminate) does not imply ||z^{k+1}-z^k|| <= tau/omega (the first term can be small while the step is large). Hence the step used to derive dist(0, partial hbar(z^{k+1},z^k)) <= tau is not justified as written.

issues.overall_effect: The output guarantee (thm3:output) is not proved by the argument given; however the conclusion is correct, because (lem3_subdiffElem) together with (lem3_b1)-(lem3_b2) shows dist(0, partial hbar(z^{k+1},z^k))^2 is bounded by the left-hand side of the stopping test, which is <= tau^2 at termination.
